# Code of conduct

This repository handles the text of the Qurʾān. Two things follow.

## Adab

Treat the text with the care its handling deserves — in commits, in issues, in
code comments and in test fixtures. Use complete references. Do not use āyahs as
throwaway sample data or placeholder strings.

Disagreement about the text is expected and welcome: the counting traditions
disagree, the packages disagree with each other, and this repository records
where they do. Bring a source. A citation settles more than an assertion, and
"the sources are the authority" is the standing rule here, not a formality.

## Conduct

Be direct about the work and courteous about the person. Critique of a
derivation, a name, a parse or a claim is the point of the project. Contempt for
the people doing it is not.

Not accepted: harassment, personal or demographic abuse, sectarian attack, or
persistent disruption after being asked to stop.

## Enforcement

Report to **service@quran.ws**. Reports are read by the maintainers and kept
confidential. Responses run from a private word, through removal of a comment,
to a ban — chosen to fit what happened.

Maintainers are held to this too, and more visibly.
